id: title:jabahamondes:count matched events in the connect suggestion

review.posthog_relevance: Updates the event volume calculation in marketing setup suggestions to include both matched and unmatched attribution events, potentially changing the displayed reason for connecting a platform.
review.reason: The implementation change in P1.F1.H1 replaces a single-line volume calculation with a conditional expression summing two attribution counters. This is a substantive, bounded change to the marketing setup suggestions, potentially affecting the displayed reason for connecting a platform. Supporting test changes are present. No broader systemic changes or unverified outcomes are ded.
review.uncertainty: The exact impact on user behavior or business metrics is not demonstrated; this is a localized implementation and test update.
